tasks.title: Add scs001-live process to ecosystem.config.js for Phase 1 live posting
tasks.description:
MODIFY ONE EXISTING FILE: ecosystem.config.js. Add ONE new PM2 process entry to the apps array. Do NOT modify any existing process entry. Do NOT modify any other file.

EXACT REQUIREMENTS:

1. In ecosystem.config.js, locate the apps array. After the LAST entry in the array (find the last `}` before the closing `]` of the apps array), append a comma after that last closing brace `}` and then the new entry.

2. The new process entry MUST be:
    {
      name: "scs001-live",
      script: "agents/scs001-orchestrator/run-pipeline.ts",
      interpreter: "node",
      interpreter_args: "-r ts-node/register",
      cwd: "/Users/tarekmnif/kognai",
      autorestart: false,
      watch: false,
      cron_restart: "0 7,12,18,21 * * *",
      args: "live",
      env: {
        TS_NODE_TRANSPILE_ONLY: "true",
        TS_NODE_PROJECT: "/Users/tarekmnif/kognai/tsconfig.scripts.json",
        OLLAMA_HOST: "http://127.0.0.1:11434",
        SCS_MODE: "live",
        TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN: process.env.TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN || "",
      },
      error_file: "/Users/tarekmnif/kognai/logs/scs001-live-error.log",
      out_file: "/Users/tarekmnif/kognai/logs/scs001-live-out.log",
      log_date_format: "YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss Z"
    }

3. The existing scs001-pipeline process (the one with args: process.env.SCS_MODE || "mock") MUST NOT be modified.

4. The file must remain valid JavaScript. The module.exports = { apps: [ ... ] } structure must be preserved.

FAIL CONDITIONS:
(1) The existing scs001-pipeline process is modified in any way
(2) args field is not the string "live"
(3) SCS_MODE is not set to "live" in the env block
(4) TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN is not passed via process.env.TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN
(5) cron_restart does not match "0 7,12,18,21 * * *"
(6) Any file other than ecosystem.config.js is modified
(7) The apps array is malformed (missing comma between entries, unmatched brackets)
(8) The process name is not exactly "scs001-live"
tasks.context: Phase 0→Phase 1 gate PASSED on Mar 16 (Sprint 096). Gate report at workspace/gates/phase0-phase1-gate.json. The existing scs001-pipeline process uses args: process.env.SCS_MODE || 'mock' — always mock because SCS_MODE is not in .env. TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN is also not set in .env. Adding a separate scs001-live entry preserves the mock fallback. The human operator must set TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env before running pm2 start ecosystem.config.js --only scs001-live. Pure JS object addition — swarm handles this reliably.
